integrity: Symbolic proof for all odd prime powers, plus an exact standalone sparse-polynomial checker for representative fields; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic only. The Hessian means the ordinary projective Hessian intersection. No assertion about all alternative Hasse-Wronskian schemes. Original Sziklai point count and classification are known; the full 2012 primary paper was inaccessible for overlap comparison.
title: Complete flex scheme of the Sziklai extremal plane curve
